name: ルカの母
trans: Is it something you can't talk about......?

name: ルカ
text:
音楽でね……こんど、
グループに分かれてはっぴょうすることになったの
trans:
During music class today, you see...
 They put us in groups, and then, we're gonna present
 a song…

name: ルカ
text:
ひとりはピアノで……
ほかの子は歌で……
trans: One plays the piano... then the others sing, and......

name: ルカ
text: ……だれも、ピアノやりたい人がいなかったの
trans: ...There was no one who could play the piano......!

name: ルカ
text:
話し合おうねって先生が言って……
でもやっぱりだれもいなくて、くじになって……
trans:
Then our teacher said, "Okay, let's talk this out,"
 then we ended up drawing lots instead, because
 still nobody wanted to play......

name: ルカ
trans: ...So we drew and I got the piano......

name: ルカ
text:
ピアノ、やったことない……
はっぴょうの日までにできなかったらどうしよう……
trans:
I've never played the piano before......
 What if I still can't play anything before the
 performance......?

name: ルカの母
text:
……そんなに悲しくなっちゃうなら──
無理はしなくていいんだよ
trans:
......If it saddens you that much, then you don't have
 to push yourself, you know—

name: ルカの母
text:
……ママから先生に言おうか
ピアノが弾ける子に代わってもらうことはできませんかって
trans:
......Should I go to your teacher? I'll tell them to have
 you switch places with someone who can actually
 play a piano.

name: ルカの母
text: そしたら考えてもらえるかも

name: ルカ
text:
くじにするって……
みんなで『いいよ』って言って……
trans: We drew lots, and...... everyone said "okay!", and......

name: ルカ
text:
わたしも、いいって……
だから……──
trans: I also agreed with it, so......

name: ルカの母
trans:
......Do you want to give it your best, even though it
 scares you?

name: ルカの母
trans: ......Just squeeze tight, and it'll be alright.

name: ルカの母
text:
ママのおまじない
……不安なことも、これで乗り越えてきたの
trans:
This is Mama's magic spell.
 Even if scary things happen, I conquered them
 because of it.

name: ルカ
text: ぎゅってすれば、だいじょうぶ……？
trans: .......just squeeze tight, and it'll be alright?

name: ルカ
text: ぎゅってすれば、だいじょうぶ────
trans: Just squeeze tight, and it'll be alright——

name: ルカの母
text:
──うん
頑張れるよ、大丈夫
trans:
——Good job.
 It'll be fine, you can definitely do it.

name: ルカの母
text:
任されたこと、
ちゃんとやり遂げようとして偉いね
trans:
You're such a good girl, wanting to finish the task
 assigned to you properly.
